The shop — handmade pieces

Every piece is made to order, in the color the buyer chooses. Custom colors are free. US-only shipping. The two trays at the end are in the preview only — they are not on the live site until you say to post them.

  • Hero slideshow: on, 4 seconds per photo

  • Process heading: “How it’s made” — three steps, one pair of hands, a kitchen scale and hand-built molds.

Shipping & returns — as the site states them

  • US only. Made to order, ships in 5 to 7 days, then about 2 to 5 days to arrive.
  • Shipping is $8.00 for the first item and $3.00 for each extra item in the same order.
  • Standard-color pieces: returnable within 14 days of delivery. Custom colors are final sale.
  • Digital downloads are final sale; a file that won’t open gets fixed or refunded by email.
  • Broken or damaged: photo within 3 days, new piece free or full refund, no return needed.
  • Contact: sfvrouqa@gmail.com — Fort Smith, Arkansas.

About this dashboard. A snapshot, not a live feed: product names, prices, photos, colors, and board settings were read from the website’s Google Sheet on Wed, Oct 28, 2026; digital prices and listing links from the Etsy listings shown on the site; scheduled posts and setup status from your Oct 27–28 notes. Analytics figures were added Mon, Nov 2, 2026 and cover Oct 5 – Nov 1, 2026 only: 46 active users, 92 sessions, 330 views, visitors by country, US state, and other region, view_item events by city (88 events, 5 total users, all from the United States), sessions by traffic source, and active users over time — per day and per week for Oct 5 – Nov 1, 2026, per month for Nov 2, 2025 – Nov 1, 2026, and per year for 2020 – Nov 1, 2026. Per-piece item-name figures were not available in the standard reports checked for that period, so Views by piece shows the total and city breakdown only. A second Analytics snapshot was added Sat, Nov 7, 2026, covering Nov 2 – Nov 7, 2026: 5 active users (2 new, 3 returning), 5 sessions, 1 engaged session, 20% engagement rate, 15 seconds average engagement time per session, 5 views (all on page path “/”), 44 events, $0 revenue, and 0 purchases, with activity only on Nov 2 and Nov 6 and no data yet for Nov 7; visitors by country and region, sessions by traffic source, and the first per-item view_item breakdown since the Item name setup (26 events: 24 named by item, 2 with no item name; 114 view_item events for Oct 5 – Nov 7, 2026 combined, 90 of them with no item name). Analytics figures always show their date range and are as of Analytics’ last processing. Use the Refresh button in the Summary to start a fresh signed-in browser read of Analytics: it takes minutes, it is not instant and not an API pull, and when the read finishes the figures are replaced with the new dated figures — or, if Analytics has processed nothing newer, the dashboard says so plainly and keeps the current dated figures. If anything changes in the Sheet, on Etsy, or in the apps, this page stays as it was until Harbor rebuilds it.
